summary: Qualification equivalency in recruitment; Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering vs Diploma in Electrical Engineering; employer's recognition of equivalence based on technical assessment; reliance on Kerala government's clarification; judicial restraint in equivalency decisions; CAT and High Court overreach; recruitment rules absence of explicit equivalence not fatal; selection based on advertised qualifications upheld; impugned judgments set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Lakshadweep Electricity Dept. (Group C and D Technical Posts) Recruitment Rules, 2002
Guru Nanak Dev University v. Sanjay Kumar Katwal
District Collector & Chairman, Vizianagaram v. M. Tripura Sundari Devi
Ashok Kumar Sharma v. Chander Shekhar
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court and CAT decisions set aside; appellants' selection restored.
